market.question: Will the highest temperature in Paris be 15°C on May 11?

assessment.reasoning: Met Office forecast for Paris-Le Bourget on May 11, 2026 is a high of 25°C (with surrounding days 22°C). The market resolves only if the high is in the 15°C bucket (i.e. essentially 15.0-15.9°C rounded). At 10°C below the forecast, probability of landing in this bucket is very low; would require a major cold/cloudy front not currently in any forecast.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Sudden front or weather model error of 5+°C; unusual but possible in spring.
